'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**[[August 2025 FARC dissidents clashes]]
***[[Colombia]]n [[Ministry of National Defense (Colombia)|defense minister]] [[Pedro Arnulfo Sánchez|Pedro Sánchez]] reports that at least 34 [[Military Forces of Colombia|soldiers]] have been kidnapped by armed civilians in [[Guaviare Department|Guaviare]] after clashes with [[FARC dissidents|dissident factions]] of the [[Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia]] that killed eleven fighters, including a commander, on Sunday. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/8/26/at-least-34-colombian-soldiers-kidnapped-after-clashes-with-farc-dissidents (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Israeli incursions in the West Bank during the Gaza war]]
***[[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli forces]] carry out a daytime raid on [[Ramallah]] in the [[West Bank]], wounding at least 58 [[Palestinians]] with gunfire and [[tear gas]]. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-west-bank-raid-violence-ramallah-b631a54e9b2149ce5b66c3aa4fac3732 (AP)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[France]] [[Repatriation (cultural property)|repatriates]] three [[French colonial empire|colonial]]-era skulls from the [[National Museum of Natural History, France|National Museum of Natural History]] in [[Paris]] to [[Madagascar]] under a 2023 [[Law of France|law]] enabling the [[Restitution and unjust enrichment|restitution]] of human remains, marking the first such handover between the two countries. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/france-returns-three-colonial-era-human-skulls-madagascar-2025-08-26/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[India–Pakistan relations]] 
**[[Pakistan]]'s [[National Disaster Management Authority (Pakistan)|National Disaster Management Authority]] evacuates more than 100,000 people from [[Punjab, Pakistan|Punjab]] after [[India]] releases water from dams into the [[Sutlej]] river, raising flood risks amid heavy monsoon rains. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-mass-evacuations-india-released-water-rains-4201f92cd951b36a2b9d9b534df1cd82 (AP)]
*At least 14 people are killed and six others are seriously injured when a four-story building collapses in [[Virar]], [[Mumbai]], [[Maharashtra]], India. '''International relations'''
*[[Australia–Iran relations]], [[Terrorism in Australia]], [[Antisemitism in Australia]]
**[[Australia]]n [[Prime Minister of Australia|prime minister]] [[Anthony Albanese]] announces the closure of the Australian embassy in [[Tehran]], the expulsion of  Iranian ambassadors from Australia, and designation of the [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] (IRGC) as a [[List of designated terrorist groups|terrorist organization]] after an [[Australian Security Intelligence Organisation]] investigation links the IRGC to least two [[antisemitic]] attacks, including the [[2024 Melbourne synagogue attack]] and an arson attack on a [[North Bondi, New South Wales|North Bondi]] [[kosher restaurant]]. [https://www.smh.com.au/politics/federal/iran-suspected-of-involvement-in-synagogue-arson-attack-20250826-p5mpx8.html (''Sydney Morning Herald'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/australia-blames-iran-antisemitic-arson-attacks-expels-envoy-2025-08-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[International sanctions against Iran]], [[Nuclear program of Iran]]
**Representatives of [[France]], [[Germany]], and the [[United Kingdom]] fail to reach an agreement with Iran in [[Geneva]], [[Switzerland]], on avoiding the possible reimposition of [[United Nations|UN]] sanctions under the [[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action|2015 nuclear deal]]'s [[United Nations Security Council Resolution 2231|snapback mechanism]], following concerns about Iran's compliance. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-nuclear-sanctions-snapback-uk-germany-france-1499eb87eccf8cb1a53425d7587941e9 (AP)]

[https://www.mprnews.org/story/2025/08/26/minneapolis-shooting-one-dead-six-hurt (MPR)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/minnesota/news/south-minneapolis-shooting-august-26-2025/ (WCCO-TV)]
*[[Porepunkah police shootings]]
**Two [[Victoria Police|police]] officers are shot and killed and a third is wounded in a suspected [[Sovereign citizen movement|sovereign citizen]] [[Terrorism in Australia|terrorist attack]] in [[Porepunkah]], [[Victoria (state)|Victoria]], Australia, sending the town into lockdown. The perpetrator remains at large. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-08-26/porepunkah-alleged-shooter-sovereign-citizen-dezi-freeman/105699366 (ABC News Australia)]
